scope: Concept and visual preview only; no game launch, no engine-verified rendering, no user approval inferred.

entries.subject: Hornbook paddle, protective sheet and attached counting beads
entries.readability_48_64: Paddle and pale lesson face distinguish the object; counting strand becomes a subordinate bead curve. Individual lesson marks are not intended to be read.
entries.notes: Hornbook shape grounded in inspected NYPL photo; bead function grounded in Library of Congress text, position is conceptual.

entries.subject: Open thick record book and one supported quill
entries.readability_48_64: Open two-page silhouette and writing tool remain distinct; repeated row marks are texture rather than readable personal names.
entries.notes: Hand-bound ledger concept, not a replica of the Aubervilliers register. Some generated marks resemble script/numerals at full master size, not reliably readable entries; no decorative title or logo. Actual source bounds retain a small clear margin before added transparent padding.

entries.subject: Chappe-style regulator with two independently hinged end indicators
entries.readability_48_64: Three-beam silhouette, mast and foot remain identifiable; fine cords and lattice slats lose detail at small sizes, especially at 32 px on dark background.
entries.notes: Central and end pivots visually connected; compact structural support is not a station building. Historical linkage verified in museum model photo. No claim that this conceptual wooden reconstruction duplicates the brass/marble artifact.
